Changes

notes.notes:
Thanks to user auguri0 for reporting this bug! =)

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.14 - 2021-04-14
notes.notes:
Thanks to user auguri0 for reporting this bug =)

Bugfixes

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.13 - 2021-02-21
notes.notes:
Thanks to user micmotorheadst for reporting these bugs, I found a few new ones as well, again =D

New Things
# Added a miniboss, Sonja, a two handed barbarian

Bugfixes
# Character hair and skin color and hairstyle will be persistant through the same session if you die and start again
# You can no longer equip both a 2h weapon and a shield
# You can now buy items if you have space in your equipment but not in your inventory, before you had to have both, weirdly enough
# The highlighting of tiles should work properly now when buying items, before it could seem like the game was stuck because items would not get highlighted when hovering them after dragging an item directly to a slot from the vendor.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.12 - 2021-02-20
notes.notes:
Thanks to user micmotorheadst for reporting this bug, I also found another one while fixing it
He also suggested an auto travel feature to town (if you are missing a TP scroll) which I will implement in the next patch

Bugfixes

# Sometimes items would not get bought when drag and dropping them to their slot, this only happened if you let go of the item in the top right corner of the item slot (in my testing anyways)
# You can no longer drag and drop items from the store to different item slots, that would just cause you to lose money but not get the item before

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1 - 2020-12-11
notes.notes:
New Things

# Added a cursor to the game instead of the default windows one
# There's now a toggle fullscreen button in the settings menu

Bugfixes

# Text is now better scaled to fit different resolutions
# When toggling to fullscreen the old resolution is no longer forced. Before you could enter fullscreen with alt + enter and it would keep the resolution making everything blurry. This is now turned off and fullscreen needs to be activated through the settings menu

Changes

# Modified stats on certain Beast enemies
# Added sound effect to skill: Poof!

Bugfixes

# Background music now loops

# Two new Helmets

notes.title: Patch Notes Alpha 0.49 - 2020-09-05

notes.title: Patch Notes Alpha 0.48 - 2020-09-01
notes.notes:
New Things

# two new weapons - Light Hammer & Spotted Light Hammer
# Couple of new sprites for rings and amulets (items will be added in the next patch)

Bugfixes
# Fixed an issue where you could gain infinite gold if you dragged a gold tile from a chest to your inventory

notes.title: Patch Notes Alpha 0.47 - 2020-08-28
notes.notes:
New Things

# Certain beasts has gotten a life leech skill called Vampiric Bite

Changes

# The log will no longer show events that has happened on invisible tiles (for example, enemys hitting eachother that you can't see)

notes.title: Patch Notes Alpha 0.46 - 2020-08-24
notes.notes:
Sorry for the very long wait for this patch, I've moved houses IRL and it's been really busy, development speed will be back to normal now!

New Things

# When toggling the inventory you now select items in the loot window by using your move keys, and you can pick up the selected item using space. I started to make the interface fully usable with the keys but I reverted it half way through because I didn't make it feel smooth. Basically you would either have to have different keys for movement or the game would be "paused" any time an UI was open (inventory, skills, loot, menu etc..). I think the current system with just being able to select things in the loot window feels pretty good but I might add additional UI movements later.
# Added a loot all function to loot all items on the tile you are standing on
# Added two new achievements
# When you kill all enemies on a level all the torches are lit up, giving you the experience

Changes

# When toggling on the loot window the inventory window also pops up. It also closes when you toggle off the loot window
# The boxes for items/skills/buffs etc are in static places instead of following the mouse
# Clicking a 1h weapon when you have no offhand will now equip it as offhand instead of switching it with your mainhand
# When picking up an equipment of a type you don't have equipped, it will be equipped instead of being looted
# Switched the default buttons for walking south and resting so you move with WASD instead of WAXD
# The settings page always starts on top now
# Increased the XP needed to level up early on since you gain alot more by automatically lighting all torches when you clear a level
# Decreased the sound of your walking steps

Bugfixes

# The game would crash if you dragged an item from the store or trader on top of another item in your inventory. It will now be returned instead.
# The game could freeze when an enemy was confused and hurt itself
# Fixed a duping bug where if you dropped items and just restarted the game you would still have your equipped items.

notes.title: Patch Notes Alpha 0.45 - 2020-07-31
notes.notes:
New Things
# A new optional dungeon called The Demonic Rift, filled with demons (ehm.. just normal enemies with red skin color right now) To make the rift appear, a ritual has to be performed
# A new NPC has moved into town, The Hermit, he sits by a campfire in his tent. If you bring him the Dark Crystal you can gain one of two passive abilities.
# The town buildings will be highlighted when hovering over them
# Added some new enemies, mainly for the new demon dungeon (restricted to that dungeon), but also a few for the others.
# Added one new ranged mini boss, The Yuppy

Changes
# Increased the amount of healing recieved by healing potions
# Added and changed descriptions for scrolls and potions

Bugfixes
# Fixed an issue with the previous patch dungeon generation where the game could black screen when entering a new level (exteremely rare)
# You can now click on the "Don't show again" button when viewing the intro scroll (before you could click the text to accept it but not the actual button)

notes.title: Patch Notes Alpha 0.44 - 2020-07-21
notes.notes:
Patch Notes Alpha 0.44 - 2020-07-21

Changes

notes.title: Patch Notes Alpha 0.43 - 2020-07-20
notes.notes:
New things
# An auto loot function, toggle it with T (can be changed in settings) and you will pick up everything you walk on. Useful in the beginning when there's not that many drops!

Bugfixes
# An inventory bug where your items could clip outside of the inventory and become non interactable when you equipped a shield and had a 2h weapon equipped

notes.title: Patch Notes Alpha 0.42 - 2020-07-19
notes.notes:
New things
# The dungeon creation system has been reworked from being just random boxes with corridors attached to being premade rooms that are placed at random with random exits and entrances. I've made an editor for myself to create these rooms so I will be able to spam out a tonne of them so it doesn't feel repeated.
# Added a dialog option to switch places with friendly NPC's, so you don't have to go around them or if they are blocking a corridor
# Added Health and Energy before the number on the bars
# Added a rumbling effect to the beast has broken his chain animation
# The messages in the center of the screen now supports more than one current message

Changes
# The first room of every level spawns with fewer mobs

Bugfixes
# HP and health will be set to max when starting a game (if your items had int or stamina on them you wouldn't start with those filled)
# Inn prices says 120g instead of 120
# The credits page on the start screen closes with Escape

notes.title: Patch Notes Alpha 0.41 - 2020-07-09
notes.notes:
Changes
# Town UI has been reworked, some other minor parts as well

Bugfixes
# Skill descriptions showing the wrong damage in the confirm box
# Hovering over gold could make the game crash
# If the first thing you hovered on was a stack of gold in a chest then it would say "x gold new item" instead of just "x gold"
# Gold spent on enchanting will now show up in statistics as spent gold

notes.title: Patch Notes Alpha 0.4 - 2020-07-08
notes.notes:
New things
# Added specific enchants for weapons, bows, shields, rings, amulets and armors. The majority of enchants are available for all items though, so you might not get specific item enchants every time like added range on bows or damage on your sword

Changes
# Turn duration for resting in the inn has been increased

Bugfixes
# Enchant alternatives and confirmation appears above all other windows. Before if you had a small enough screen your inventory would cover them.
# Fixed a bug where you can't see your target marker when shooting a bow or manually attacking (this bug was introduced 2 patches ago with the highlighting of charge spaces)
# Fixed a graphical bugs with lances, they appeared to the left of your character.

notes.title: Patch Notes Alpha 0.39 - 2020-07-07
notes.notes:
New things

Bugfixes
# Ring of Major Resistance no longer costs 1g
# Opening the stats page when the skillbook is open will properly close the skillbook

notes.title: Patch Notes Alpha 0.38 - 2020-07-07
notes.notes:
Changes
# The cloud animation has gotten sped up, and it's also slightly transparent so it's easier to see enemies when it's being dissolved
# Merchants will teleport themselves to a random tile if they are stuck in a corridor, they cannot walk into corridors unless chasing enemies as to not block the player

Bugfixes
# Teleportation traps can no longer teleport you to an occupied tile
# Merchants can no longer walk through walls

notes.title: Patch Notes Alpha 0.37 - 2020-07-06
notes.notes:
Changes
# Charge now shows you the trail where you will move

Bugfixes
# Solar staff now has attack damage
# Clouds gets removed when you use the Reveal map scroll
# Fixed a bug where you could attack tiles further away than intended by switching skills

notes.title: Patch Notes Alpha 0.36 - 2020-07-05
notes.notes:
New Things
# Two new daggers - Mustache Handle Dagger & Ceremonial Dagger
# Two new spears - Halberd & Royal Halberd
# One new one handed sword/spear - Mini Lance
# Two new Amulets - Amulet of Precision & Amulet of The Thief

Changes
# Torches now activate when walking towards that wall tile, so you don't have to click them.
# Removed the throw right click action on potions. It has never been implemented but I thought the button already was hidden.
# The game is now paused when the settings menu is active, meaning you can't click on other things.

Bugfixes
# Dragging items around in a merchants inventory will return them to their original position and not cost you money.
# Right clicking on scrolls now says use instead of equip
# Right click buttons for selling/dropping in town does not freeze the game anymore

notes.title: Patch Notes Alpha 0.35 - 2020-06-29
notes.notes:
New Things
# One new skill - Poof! - Teleports an enemy to a random location
# Added a cloud effect to undiscovered tiles with a tiny animation when that tile is discovered. this might be removed in a future patch, I'm not quite sure if I like it or not

Bugfixes
# Increased Quality skill is now a passive skill (before it was added to your hotbar but you could not cast it, it always worked though)

notes.title: Patch Notes Alpha 0.34 - 2020-06-24
notes.notes:
Mini patch because the bug really annoyed me, I believe I fixed it earlier but re introduced it in a later patch...

New Things
# Two new Robes

Bugfixes
# Fixed a bug with blade flurry where your opponent could attack between your attacks

notes.title: Patch Notes Alpha 0.33 - 2020-06-23
notes.notes:
New Things
# Two new skills that requires two handed weapons.
	Line Smash - Attacks three tiles in a direction of your choosing. known as the corridor massacre
	Powerful Bash - High damage, high chance to stun
# When using a skill or casting a spell, such as firebolt, the affected AoE tiles will be highlighted. 
	

Changes
# All skills now show the actual damage, including your weapon damage (if applicable) and extra damage from stats

Bugfixes
# Fixed a graphical issue where you could click buttons in your skillbook while it was hidden, preventing you from clicking other things

notes.title: Patch Notes Alpha 0.32 - 2020-06-22
notes.notes:
Very small patch because I felt the game crashing bug had to be pushed quickly

New Things

# New skill - Barter, better vendor prices

Changes

# Done a couple of minor graphical changes in town, they might have been released between 0.31 and 0.32 though with no other differences.

Bugfixes

# Fixed a bug where the game could freeze when spawning bosses if you had recently loaded the game
# Fixed graphical issues with skill descriptions

notes.title: Patch Notes Alpha 0.31 - 2020-06-18
notes.notes:
Changes

# The town has been redrawn and been made scalable ( sort of anyways ). Before if you had certain screen sizes some things would not be visible, like the cave, which made the game unplayable.

notes.title: Patch Notes Alpha 0.3 - 2020-06-14
notes.notes:
New things
# Added mini bosses on certain levels, a bit more difficult mobs than normal ones but they carry decent loot, usually. There's a total of 10 bosses so far but more will be added. 
# Added two new crossbows - Rusty Crossbow & Steel Crossbow
# Added two new staves - Solar Staff & Void Staff
# Added three new scrolls - Enchant item, Fortify Armor and Reveal Map
# All armours (chests, boots, gloves, heads and shields) can be upgraded to +5, same as with weapons. Upgrades are different based on the item and can boost any attribute. For example Robes tend to mainly increase intellect and shields mostly adds armor.
# Added one new skill - Increased Quality (increases the chance of higher tiered items)

Changes
# Higher level loot drops will be more likely the further the game progresses (random drops, enemies gear, store & trader inventory)
# New XP requirements for each level, leveling up more slowly in the beginning but being able to reach a higher level in total, before the xp required just tripled every level
# Changed how visibility works to fix an issue where enemies could shoot you from the dark as well as some enemies just standing still when you can see them (from their perspective the tile you were standing on were not visible)
# All traps and buffs now deal true damage, meaning the damage will not be reduced by armor or resistance. The only exception is poison effects which can be reduced by 1 from the witch doctor passive skill
# Critical damage enchant has had it's effect decreased
# Critical chance enchant has had it's effect decreased

Bugfixes
# Statistics will now be recorded correctly
# Stun/Confuse/Curse immunity now works as they should.
# Resistance is shown up as an item stat instead of an enchant stat (basically just white text instead of blue)
# Items in the enchantress window will now be centered
# Tweaked the level generation which should result in no more seeing the other side of walls
# Fixed a bug with the teleport trap an enemies where they would sort of flicker and fly around after stepping on one
# Fixed a bug where you could travel multiple levels by spamming right click on stairs
# Fixed a bug with shield knockback damage, the player would take 4x the supposed damage when hitting a wall after being knockbacked with a shield

notes.title: Patch Notes Alpha 0.29 - 2020-06-05
notes.notes:
New things
# Steam status, for others who owns the game your class, level and location will be shown when viewing your profile
# Added Sound effects on button clicks
# Added Sound effects on teleportation traps
# Added Sound effect when leveling up


Bugfixes
# All gold dropped on a tile will be picked up when stepping on it, before it only took the first one (if two or more enemies had dropped gold on the same tile).

notes.title: Patch Notes Alpha 0.28 - 2020-06-03
notes.notes:
New things
# 2 new one handed weapons
# 3 new Crossbows

Bugfixes
# Ranged weapons never got the boost of agility properly. Agility bow builds should be much more viable now

notes.title: Patch Notes Alpha 0.27 - 2020-05-31
notes.notes:
New things
# Introduced a couple of achievements, just a few for now, but the system is implemented to easily add more

Changes
# The telport int range modifier has been lowered

Bugfixes
# Fixed a bug where the create enemy scroll could spawn monsters outside of the map freezing the game
# Dual wieling damage now properly works, the offhand dealt more damage than the main hand before.

notes.title: Patch Notes Alpha 0.26 - 2020-05-24
notes.notes:
New things
# Four new shields
# Teleportation trap, teleports the user to a random location
# New spell: Thunderstrike - Decent damage, 100% 2 turn stun
# Drawn more images for different potions and scrolls
# Added a few energy gain potion with different strengths

Changes
# The cost of shields has been increased (all shields were 50g before)
# Thunderbolt now has an 80% chance of stunning 1-2 turns, reduced from 100.
# Confusion bolt costs 8 energy instead of 2

Bugfixes
# Fixed a bug where the create enemy scroll could spawn monsters outside of the map freezing the game

notes.title: Patch Notes Alpha 0.25 - 2020-05-22
notes.notes:
New things
# Wells and Blood wells are added! These wells can be drunk from, effects varies.
# 2 new skills
	Spell Offensive: Poison Blast - Poison all enemies around you
	Spell Passive: Witch Doctor - 1 less damage from all poison attacks (including debuffs)

Changes
# The damage reduction of the armor stat has been reduced.
# The damage reduction of the resistance stat has been reduced.
# The speed of the beast has been slowed down
# Buff durations will no longer stack, they will get refreshed if the new buff has a higher duration.
# Armor now works against bow attacks, but with reduced efficiency
# All non humanoid enemies has gotten their damage modified, some higher some lower
# Energy costs of all skills has been changed
# The beast now unlocks skills on certain levels (will be waaay more difficult to kill than before)
# The beast's stats has been modified, making him do more damage with normal hits but lower health and other stats (and because of that lower damage with skills)
# Frozen bolt was removed, the freezing effect wasn't implemented yet

Bugfixes
# Armor and resistance actually works properly now. Before you could either resist or not resist, now it will actually decrease the damage as well
# Enemies can now spawn with shields
# Enemies can now use shield skills
# Fixed a bug where dual wielding enemies could freeze the game when attacking with their offhand weapon
# You no longer become bald when equipping and unequipping a head armor that doesn't cover your entire face
# You can now drop items from your inventory to the loot window without having to refresh it to pick it up again
# Fixed an issue where torches sometimes lit up tiles on other sides of walls
# Fixed an issue where you would get teleported back to town if you started the game and closed it without doing any action
# Fixed an issue where the game would crash if you tried to continue a game while having any buff
# All chests used to spawn as "Tiny chests" meaning few items, while 10-25% depending on level should have had more items in them

notes.title: Patch Notes Alpha 0.24 - 2020-05-14
notes.notes:
**Please note that the weapon enchants only starts to work with games created after this update is installed**

Changes
# Adding a point in vitality also gives you one health (not only maximum health)
# You can now enchant your weapons with the scroll of enchant weapon, up to +5. The effects damage and range and they are different for each weapon. They are also hidden. Note that they are fractions so you might not always see the difference if you go from +0 to +1, if it lets say gives 0.33 extra damage, then you will see that change when it's +2.
# The vitality buff potion has been removed
# The damage reduction of the armor stat has been reduced slightly.

Bugfixes
# Enchants applied will add the effect immediately, before you needed to re equip the item
# The stat Resistance didn't show up in descriptions except for enchants
# Fixed an issue where all projectiles were black

notes.title: Patch Notes Alpha 0.23 - 2020-05-13
notes.notes:
Bugfixes
# Fixed an issue where you couldn't double click on items, introduced in patch 0.22

notes.title: Patch Notes Alpha 0.22 - 2020-05-13
notes.notes:
Bugfixes
# Fixed an issue where an enemy could be halted during an attack and stuck indefinitely. (Major bug)
# Fixed an issue where you could use a potion or scroll from the loot menu when your inventory was full, this would crash the game. You can only use items that are in your inventory.

notes.title: Patch Notes Alpha 0.21 - 2020-05-12
notes.notes:
Bugfixes
# Fixed an issue where blade flurry would lock your game if the enemy died before the last attack
# Fixed an issue where blade flurry attacked three times instead of two
# Fixed an issue where blade flurry attacked with both weapons instead of just the mainhand as the description says (resulting in a total of 6 attacks instead of 2)
# Fixed an issue with the interact function that was released in alpha 0.2 where you would move as well as right clicking a neighboring tile
# Fixed an issue where the appropriate item slot would always be red when hovering over it with a shield
# Fixed an issue where the background colors of equipped items would dissppear

notes.title: Patch Notes Alpha 0.2 - 2020-05-12
notes.notes:
Changes
# Items which you cannot afford will list their price in red
# Added an interact function, it does the same thing as right clicking a tile next to you but is accessible without a mouse. The default keybind is R
# Added a couple of new enemies, and adjusted the stats & xp/gold rewards of others

Bugfixes
# Fixed an issue where chests could spawn on stairs
# Fixed a softlock where you would be unable to act if you had an active skill while switching level
# Changed so that scroll of identify will be cancelled if you perform any action other than clicking on an item to identify it
# Fixed an issue where skill slot 2-10 would all activate skill slot 2.
